about: Full-stack web developer with 5+ years of experience shipping production web applications in logistics, enterprise reporting, and Web3. Day-to-day work is React and TypeScript on the frontend with Java and PostgreSQL on the backend. I have taken products through micro-frontend migrations, built shared component libraries used across multiple modules, and handled real-time data, JWT/RBAC security, and test coverage. I use AI coding tools such as Cursor and Claude for prototyping, debugging, and documentation, and treat their output as a first draft to review rather than code to ship.

projects.name: Dynamic Terminal System
projects.description: A multi-tenant, multi-site, multi-language platform that lets each terminal and facility run on its own configuration from a single codebase, currently serving 3 terminals.
highlights: Developed CANDI, a component-based React framework that renders screens from JSON configuration instead of hardcoded components
Migrated the frontend to a micro-frontend architecture so each module builds and deploys independently, removing release coordination between module teams
Built the shared UI library — dynamic grids, forms, input controls, and layout utilities — rolled out across modules, with 6 developers building on it
Added filtering, sorting, pagination, column configuration, and persisted grid state so users keep their view between sessions
Implemented role-based authentication and authorization so access is controlled per site and per user role
Configured Webpack to output static HTML builds for deployment inside restricted, network-isolated terminal environments

projects.name: Cerebital
projects.description: Dashboard frontend with resizable panels, dynamic grids, and drag-and-drop for tabs and rows, so users could rearrange layouts around their own workflow.
highlights: Wrote the REST API in Node.js and Express using a routes / controllers / services structure, serving 18 endpoints to dashboards, Kanban boards, timelines, and analytics widgets
Added real-time data sync over Socket.io and moved aggregation to the server, reducing dashboard load time by 20% on datasets of 80,000 rows
Integrated visualization widgets using Chart.js, Recharts, D3, Vis.js, React-Flow, and Three.js, and converted Figma designs into responsive SCSS layouts
Secured the API with JWT authentication, role-based access control, and Express middleware (helmet, express-rate-limit, express-validator) for CORS policies, rate limiting, and input validation
Wrote unit and integration tests with Jest, React Testing Library, and Supertest, reaching 98% coverage across components, API routes, and middleware

projects.name: Product Forecast Web App
projects.description: Sales forecasting dashboard with Scatter, Line/Bar, Forecast, Sankey, and Network charts so teams could compare the same projection across different views.
highlights: Implemented hierarchical role-based access so each sales role only saw data at or below their level in the org structure, supporting 5 role tiers
Added date, product-category, and multi-parameter filters to let users narrow a forecast down to a specific segment
Built Excel import and export so users could download forecast data, edit it offline, and upload revisions back into the app, replacing a manual process that took 2 hours per cycle
Delivered the app as micro-frontends so individual dashboard modules could be released independently

projects.name: Social Media Platform for NFT Holders
projects.description: Wallet-based login with MetaMask and Coinbase Wallet, replacing passwords with signature-based authentication.
highlights: Added an interactive world map showing where other holders of the same collection were located
Built real-time chat so holders could message each other and discuss collections directly in the app
Built a posts and comments system where users publish their own NFTs with images and descriptions, and reply to other holders' posts
Integrated the Moralis NFT API to pull live sales, ownership, and price data for each token
